title: Cloud PR-review omp exception to A1 was recorded by a worker, not the operator
body:
Tick 8em closed A1's cloud PR-review gap by appending a note to epic 43y that declares the omp review boot an exception 'now on the record'. The operator's recorded exceptions cover only the local claude rung (and the j6o review/closeout blessing). A worker-authored exception to an acceptance item should be confirmed by the operator at close-out, or the review boot moved onto pi-durable.
evidence: .tick/issues/43y.json notes 2026-10-05 18:25; cloudflare/src/worker-boot.ts:504,529; cloudflare/src/run-workflow.ts:1756
